output.headline: Provider-focused sponsor with an open platform, six Midwest deals and a record of paying upper-quartile multiples for a $200M, 16.8%-margin target.
output.differentiator: Pairs an open platform with six Midwest deals; GTCR matches the Midwest count but has no open platform. Its $172M median deal is closest to the $200M target alongside GTCR's $173M.
output.why_them: Add-on to its open platform; pays above the 75th percentile

acquirer_overview.title: A healthcare-focused sponsor with 23 deals and a Midwest footprint
points: Financial sponsor with 23 deals from 2017 to 2023; 18 closed (78%), 8 of them since 2022 [T:record, K:closed_share, K:recent].
Mandate covers technology and healthcare; a press headline cites a raise of over $5 billion in its largest fund to date (2023) [P:1, P:2].
Provider specialist: 16 of 23 deals in provider services, 6 in the Midwest, median deal $172M [A:angles, T:record].

strategic_fit_thesis.title: An add-on to its open platform, backed by a provider record
points: Deals in this or neighbouring sub-sectors are the strongest factor in its favour: 1 in the target's own sub-sector, 15 in adjacent provider sub-sectors [S:sector_rel, T:record].
Cross-sell is a distinct motive: 8 of 23 deals, against 21% of all deals in the file [M:cross_sell].
Bought Jefferson Ambulatory Care in the target's own sub-sector and region; its open platform makes the target an add-on [D:MA-2021-0083, A:angles].

precedent_activity.title: Midwest and provider precedents at multiples above the comparable range
points: Jefferson Ambulatory Care: $75M Management Buyout, 2021, Midwest, 17.8x EBITDA, closed [D:MA-2021-0083].
Woodland PACE: $204M Management Buyout, 2021, 17.6x EBITDA, closed; closest in size to the target [D:MA-2021-0025].
Clearwater Mental Health: $398M Recapitalization, 2023, Midwest, 16.8x, withdrawn. 9 of 23 deals sit in the $100M-$400M size band [D:MA-2023-0166, K:size_band].

valuation_context.title: Upper-quartile pricing is defensible, and this buyer has paid it
points: 70 comparable deals show 10.7x at the 25th percentile, 12.8x median and 15.3x at the 75th percentile [V:comps].
The target's 16.8% margin sits above the comps' median of 12.9% and above 87% of comps, supporting the 75th percentile [V:comps].
Its median paid is 16.2x [T:record]. At 5.0x leverage the equity cheque is $128M; maximum price is $193M at the same exit, $216M at a 15.0x platform exit [V:lbo].

risk_flags.title: Return at the asking price
risk_flags.concern: IRR at the ask of 18.7% is below the 20% target [V:lbo].
risk_flags.mitigant: A platform exit at 15.0x lifts the maximum price to $216M [V:lbo].
risk_flags.reality: At the same exit the maximum is $193M, so the bid depends on the add-on exit [V:lbo].

risk_flags.title: Completion record
risk_flags.concern: The share of its deals that closed, 18 of 23 (78%), is a slight factor against it [S:close_rate_s, K:closed_share].
risk_flags.mitigant: It closed Jefferson Ambulatory Care, a Midwest deal in the target's own sub-sector [D:MA-2021-0083].
risk_flags.reality: Two of its six listed precedents were withdrawn, including Clearwater Mental Health at $398M [D:MA-2023-0166, D:MA-2022-0024].

risk_flags.title: Thin record in the target's own sub-sector
risk_flags.concern: Only 1 deal in the target's own sub-sector, against 5 for Advocate Health and 4 for Nordic Capital [T:record].
risk_flags.mitigant: It has 15 deals in adjacent provider sub-sectors and an open platform [T:record, A:angles].
risk_flags.reality: Nordic Capital also has an open platform and 18 adjacent deals, so expect competition [A:angles].

conviction.rationale: Rests on 1 deal in the target's own sub-sector, 15 in adjacent provider sub-sectors, and an open platform offering an add-on route; the completion record is the main offset [C:conviction, S:close_rate_s].
